QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Playing Courier
QuestInfo.0: Leon took off after Zion. Before you could give chase, Gilberto said he had a favor to ask...
QuestInfo.1: Leon took off after Zion. Before you could give chase, Gilberto said he had a favor to ask... He had a letter for Vaughn Tremier.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Gilberto's letter to Vaughn Tremier, and were met with scoffing laughter. It was harsh, but you're in no position to question him. Gilberto will need to know.

0.0: My hunch was correct. I'm glad to see Leon so passionate about something other than looking handsome. He reconfirmed my own suspicions of their offer.
0.1: But Leon rejected them right off the bat. He was thinking of the people of Commerci first. He behaved like a true leader.
0.2: Pardon my fatherly pride. We have urgent matters to discuss, if you would.

yes.0: If there is one family in Commerci as influential and clever as we Daniellas, it's the Tremier Merchant Union.
yes.1: #bVaughn Tremier#k is a meticulous and cunning man. A man after my own heart, truth be told.
yes.2: He and I have a bit of a... rivalry, but I believe we can bury the axe long enough to deal with this problem. Please take him this letter.

npc.0: Vaughn Tremier will be nearby, just to the east.
